page.overview:
Who is Kraken?

Kraken is the Fiend of Water from the original Final Fantasy. He appears in the Sunken Shrine and bears a squid-like form, though his cape and stance give him a somewhat regal appearance. Two hundred years before the game, as the second Fiend to awaken, kraken sank the Water Crystal's shrine to the ocean floor, whereupon the seas raged as the Crystal was drained of its power. This also caused the destruction of the civilization that used to live in Onrac during the past. The kraken's actions also caused less light to be shone beneath the sea, which threaten the lives of the mermaids living in the Sunken Shrine. The Warriors of Light were able to go to the Sunken Shrine using a barrel submarine in Onrac and having oxyale with them. They then defeated the kraken and restored the Water Crystal, causing the sea to become peaceful once again as well as causing light to shine underwater again as well.

He later appears in the Chaos Shrine of the past, where his floor contains many monsters from the Sunken Shrine. The party defeats him once more in order to go deeper into the shrine.

His recurring trademark laughter is "Oh, ho, ho, ho". It is in Final Fantasy IV: The After Years and Dissidia Final Fantasy. It is in the original version of Final Fantasy, In the original version of Final Fantasy, his laughter is "fo, fo, fo"
